label: Teltonika TRB245
description: An industrial M2M 4G gateway with one 10/100 Ethernet port that can be used as WAN or LAN, plus digital inputs, a relay and a serial interface. One port, so the routing decision is which side it is on.
notes: Vendor figures from the TRB245 datasheet: 1 x LAN port 10/100 Mbps, IEEE 802.3/802.3u, which the vendor notes can be used as a WAN port; 4G LTE Cat 4; digital inputs, relay output and RS232/RS485. Named lan1 rather than wan because the vendor's default role is LAN.
